subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should fallback-only verification ship as `/models test-fallback`, as a scoped mode of `openclaw models status --probe`, or through both entry points backed by one implementation?
rationale: The capability is still missing, but selecting the durable public UX requires balancing active-agent chat convenience against avoiding a second diagnostic command family alongside broader model-health work.

options.title: Extend status probe
options.body: Add configured-fallback target selection to `models status --probe` and keep model diagnostics in one CLI command family.

options.title: Shared CLI and slash entry
options.body: Expose both surfaces only if active-agent chat diagnostics are important, while sharing target resolution and execution.

options.title: Dedicated slash command
options.body: Implement only `/models test-fallback`, accepting a separate diagnostic surface focused on the active agent’s fallback order.

recommendation.title: Extend status probe
recommendation.body: Add configured-fallback target selection to `models status --probe` and keep model diagnostics in one CLI command family.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the clearest issue-specific product assessment and have the strongest combined fallback and model-status provenance.
